doc.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Maynard Ferguson and Dizzy's big band
title: Pay in the bands
summary: Pay was terrible with the most popular leaders, while Dizzy paid well.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: When you say paid better, what was pay during that time?
It was bad, unbelievably bad. The guys that were making the most money in most cases were paying the least. Lionel Hampton. He was the most popular band out there. Paid the least.
When you were with Diz for that year, did you need to do any other work?
You worked. So you could make a year’s salary.
Yeah. He paid a good price for the music. He paid the guys good. Some guys were making more than me, because they were doing things – more important things in the band than I was.
